one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent planned and executed the entire optimization while consistently targeting '/app/x_solution.npy' instead of the required '/app/solution.txt', and then declared task completion without ever producing the correct output artifact.
t_err_evidence: Step 1: the agent's initial task plan explicitly lists 'Save to /app/x_solution.npy' as the output target, showing the wrong output path was assumed from the very start without reading or verifying the task specification.
t_commit_evidence: Step 6: the projected gradient descent runs to completion and saves the solution to '/app/x_solution.npy' (np.save); this is the first real state-changing write to disk, locking in the wrong artifact path. All subsequent steps validate or track this wrong file without ever correcting the path.
t_surface_evidence: Step 11: the agent calls finish() claiming all requirements are met while referencing '/app/x_solution.npy'; no '/app/solution.txt' was ever written, so the test harness would find the required file missing. This is the first externally observable failure signal.
trigger_explanation: The agent never read or verified the task specification for the required output file format and path. It assumed a NumPy binary '.npy' file was appropriate and planned around '/app/x_solution.npy' from step 1 onward, never questioning whether the test harness expected a text file at '/app/solution.txt'.
